## Snapshot

- New snapshot directory and predecessor, if any
- Research added or corrected and the reason for the change
- Replay or review evidence with exact scope

## Before merging

- [ ] The staged inventory matches the intended sources, proofs, data, scripts, and results.
- [ ] Provenance and exact versus numerical evidence are recorded.
- [ ] Sensitive and third-party material was reviewed. External references have citations.
- [ ] The integrity check passes and past snapshot directories retain their original bytes.
- [ ] The new snapshot includes recovery and replay instructions appropriate to its contents.
